questions.q: What are the small dark round nuclei scattered in the pink background?

questions.q: Which feature identifies cerebellar cortex rather than cerebral cortex?
options: A row of Purkinje cells between molecular and granular layers
A central canal lined by ependymal cells
questions.explain: Cerebellar cortex has three layers with Purkinje cells; cerebral cortex has six.
